packageRules.description: Once a week (schedule:weekly, Monday before 4am): one PR for every minor and patch update.
And one PR for every major update, kept apart so a breaking change doesn't hold up the rest.
The azurerm pin is ~> 5.8.0 in every module, and the pin check needs them equal.

description: Renovate handles version updates. Dependabot handles security updates (.github/dependabot.yml), so Renovate opens no vulnerability PRs.
